# Speaker Deck

> Speaker Deck is a presentation sharing platform that enables creators to easily upload, share, and discover presentations across diverse topics including technology, design, business, education, and research.

Speaker Deck provides both free and Pro subscription tiers for sharing presentations online. The platform hosts a curated community of presentations organized by category, featuring speaker profiles and a featured gallery of high-quality content.

## Key Topics

- Presentation Sharing
- Speaker Deck Pro
- Design Systems
- SEO & Marketing
- Programming & PHP
- AI & Machine Learning
- Technology & Cloud
- Portfolio Design
- Privacy Controls
- Content Strategy
- UI/UX Design
- Academic Presentations
- Animation & Storyboards
- Multilingual Content
- Upload Management

## Platform Core

- [Speaker Deck](https://speakerdeck.com): Speaker Deck homepage showcasing presentation sharing platform
- [Features](https://speakerdeck.com/features): Features overview for Speaker Deck and Speaker Deck Pro plans
- [Speaker Deck Pro](https://speakerdeck.com/pro): Speaker Deck Pro pricing and subscription features page

## Featured & Community

- [Featured Decks](https://speakerdeck.com/p/featured): Featured presentations gallery showcasing community content

## Presentation Categories

- [Technology](https://speakerdeck.com/c/technology): Technology category with Kubernetes, PHP, and cloud talks
- [Programming](https://speakerdeck.com/c/programming): Programming talks collection covering PHP, Dart, and development
- [Design](https://speakerdeck.com/c/design): Design category gallery with UX and creative presentations
- [Business](https://speakerdeck.com/c/business): Business category directory of curated presentations
- [Science & Research](https://speakerdeck.com/c/science): Science presentations with machine learning and data analysis
- [Research](https://speakerdeck.com/c/research): Research and academic presentations directory with AI research
- [Marketing & SEO](https://speakerdeck.com/c/marketing-and-seo): Marketing and SEO presentations directory with strategy content
- [Education](https://speakerdeck.com/c/education): Education category with lecture materials and teaching resources
- [How-to & DIY](https://speakerdeck.com/c/how-to-diy): How-to guides and DIY tutorials collection with technical talks
- [Storyboards](https://speakerdeck.com/c/storyboards): Storyboards gallery for animation and film production content
